question: What did the July 2019 cloud GR change?
gold_answer: Added rules on which data moves to cloud, archival and periodic review. No deadline or amount change

gold_grs_detail.title: Cloud Computing Policy- Instructions to Departments regarding hosting of IT applications

product.answer: The July 2019 cloud GR (201907051642210511, dated 05-07-2019) issued instructions to all government departments, sub-ordinate offices, public sector undertakings, urban and rural local bodies, and other state-established bodies to define and communicate cloud-hosted data and time periods to DIT in writing, confirm data to archive, verify datasets for automated removal, ensure pre-migration review for existing applications, and periodically review cloud applications and data for efficiency.

product.answer: The 2021-04-23 GR amends the July 2019 cloud GR by requiring all government departments to procure cloud services through the GeM portal, ending the previous empanelment on 30-04-2021, and mandating migration to a new cloud within 46 days with the empanelment rate expiring on 15-06-2021. Earlier, the July 2019 GR instructed departments to define data for cloud migration in writing and to periodically review applications on cloud for efficiency and cost.
